newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr National announces management changes.
newsitem.headline: Cr National announces management changes.

text.p: Credit National Chairman Emmanuel Rodocanachi proposed to the French banking group's board on Tuesday to name Dominique Ferrero managing director.
The move is part of a management reorganisation, the bank said in a statement.
Ferrero is former managing director of trade finance bank Banque Francaise du Commerce Exterieur (BFCE), bought by Credit National at the end of 1995.
Ferrero will coordinate the banking group's functions, the bank said.
Ferrero also proposed the appointment of Herve Schrike as head of Financiere Saint-Dominique.
